author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
translation: V. In the body of every one, i.e., in the gross body, in the subtle body called Lingasarjra, and in the spiritual self, of every soul, He, the aforesaid Lord stands as the Protector.' So the soul who dwells in the body is ever indestructible’ Therefore, i.e., since the Lord stands there as the Protector and consequently the soul cannot be annihilated, or changed, thou hast no reason to grieve for any being.
